description: This Perl module provides internationalization support for the Git application using gettext via the Locale::Messages module. It sets up functions for translation (__), pluralization (__n), and a no-operation placeholder (N__). It also includes logic to stub out translation functions if Locale::Messages is unavailable.

methods.name: __bootstrap_locale_messages
methods.description: Initializes gettext localization by setting the locale and binding message domains.
